subject: Rare geo premium & sign-on bundle — decision needed
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@talentbridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Candidate Alex Santoro — request for exception (geo premium + sign-on + equity refresh)

Hi Soojin,

Quick note — Alex Santoro (ex-Lead Infra at Orbit Analytics) is at final-stage and verbally accepted, but he has two competing offers and needs an updated package to commit. Hiring manager asked us to see if Redwood can make a one-time exception.

Requested exceptions (summary):
- One-time cash sign-on: $45,000 (outside standard band for US-remote in APAC hire)
- Equity refresh: 0.5% non-standard refresh to get him to parity with internal peers
- Accelerated vesting: 25% first-year cliff (otherwise standard 4yr)
- Location premium: treat as US-equivalent for OTE calculation (candidate is relocating from EMEA)

Attached: candidate_resume.pdf, comp_benchmarking_Q4_2027.pdf (benchmarks and Orbit comps).

Manager (Hannah, copied in Greenhouse) says losing Alex will push their roadmap back by two quarters — this is a mission-critical infra hire for the inference serving team. Can you advise on approval path and whether Redwood would entertain a split-pay sign-on or time-vested retention to mitigate budget?

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Senior Recruiter, TalentBridge
Attachment: candidate_resume.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: comp_benchmarking_Q4_2027.pdf (pdf)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-04T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Candidate Alex Santoro — request for exception (geo premium + sign-on + equity refresh)

Folks — forwarding recruiter note and benchmarks. Quick context from hiring:
- Role: Principal Inference Infra (IC), replacement role approved in H2 hiring plan (headcount available).
- Risk: Candidate has two competing offers; manager is asking for an above-band package to close.
- Comp constraints: base is at top of band already; request is mainly for cash sign-on + equity refresh + accelerated vest.

Recommendation from manager: approve a one-time sign-on and a limited equity refresh. Proposed concrete package for approval:
- Sign-on: $45,000 total but paid 75% at start, 25% after 12 months (retention holdback)
- Equity: 0.45% refresh (one-time grant) with 20% accelerated vesting first year
- No change to base salary; band parity maintained.

Rationale: narrow candidate fit, high impact hire, and manager will accept the split-pay structure to mitigate budget impact. Attached benchmarking shows this is elevated vs our standard band but in line with Orbit and other infra shops.

Asks:
- Karthik / Ben: quick confirmation on (1) headcount/budget available (should be ok per hiring plan) and (2) if finance will accept split-pay + retention holdback for sign-on.
- Marissa: OK from People Ops on the equity refresh + vesting schedule?

If we can get a greenlight by EOD Monday (2027-12-06), manager will push the official offer and DocuSign link.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-05T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate Alex Santoro — request for exception (geo premium + sign-on + equity refresh)

Thanks for the context. Two quick points:
1) Headcount: confirmed — this is within the approved H2 infra hiring plan (no additional authorization required).
2) Budget: we have some flexibility, but let's try to reduce immediate cash outflow if possible. Can we consider $35k up-front and $10k as a retention tranche after 12 months (as Soojin suggested)? Finance prefers that structure.

Also, Marissa, any regulatory or equity pool constraints we should be aware of before we commit to 0.45%? If we need to compress, suggest 0.35–0.40% instead.

If everyone is aligned on split-pay and equity at ~0.4% (with 20% first-year vest), I can sign off from hiring/biz side — Ben will need to confirm cash timing.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Infra & Serving Runtime
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-06T15:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate Alex Santoro — request for exception (geo premium + sign-on + equity refresh)

Finance note / decision: after reviewing the benchmarking and runway impact, finance will approve the package with the following conditions:
- Sign-on: approve $45,000 total but paid as $35,000 at start + $10,000 retention paid after 12 months (contingent on continued employment)
- Equity refresh: approve 0.40% (one-time grant) with 20% accelerated vest in year 1
- All payments to be routed through payroll/total rewards with standard tax withholding and retention clause documented in the offer

Please update the offer template with the retention clause and have Legal review the equity scope. Marissa: please confirm equity grant paperwork and notify Total Rewards to reserve pool.

Once those items are in place, Soojin — you have finance sign-off to issue the offer subject to legal/total rewards paperwork.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine@talentbridge.com>
Date: 2027-12-06T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Final: Candidate Alex Santoro — offer to proceed

Thanks all — good to have the decision. I will:
- Update the offer letter with split sign-on and retention clause
- Set equity refresh to 0.40% with 20% first-year vesting
- Send to Legal & Total Rewards for paperwork (links below)
- Push DocuSign once Legal gives the OK; plan to send to candidate today 12/06 EOD PT

Links: https://greenhouse.inc/applications/ORB-1423, https://docs.google.com/document/d/1_offer_template

Closing note for the record: manager confirmed this is the final concession they can make to close. Candidate profile was compelling on latency/serving experience and Orbit-specific KV cache work.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
